# Design point P021

## Description

The system would replicate and distribute repository state at the Git-object level, while clients use a virtualized filesystem to defer file population and reduce checkout and working-tree costs. These mechanisms are not inherently incompatible, but the virtualized-filesystem choice is marked rejected, so this combination is only a partial or non-adopted design.
